title: Change a value with set
objective: Give a changing variable a new value with set, and understand why a normal make cannot be changed.

body.text: A variable made with make keeps its first value. To change a value later, make the variable changing, and use set to give it a new value. Write set, the name, to, and the new value. The new value replaces the old one, and it does not add to it.

body.title: Replace a value
body.code:
make changing score equal to 0
set score to 10
say score
make changing name equal to "old"
set name to "new"
say name
make changing found equal to false
set found to true
say found

body.text: The new value must be the same kind as the old one. A number stays a number, and text stays text. Setting a value of a different kind is a compile error, so the compiler stops before the program runs. Setting a name that was never made changing is also a compile error.

body.title: The value can come from another variable
body.code:
make changing level equal to 1
make bumped equal to level plus 1
set level to bumped
say "Level {level}"

body.prompt: The score starts at 0 but should be 10 by the time it prints. Make it print 10.
body.starter:
make changing score equal to 0
say score
body.solution:
make changing score equal to 0
set score to 10
say score
